mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_members (group_id, student_id, student_name, student_number, class_name, join_time, role, join_status) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{studentNumber}, #{className}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{role}, #{joinStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_name = VALUES(student_name), student_number = COALESCE(VALUES(student_number), group_members.student_number), class_name = VALUES(class_name), role = VALUES(role), join_status = VALUES(join_status)
